command:
set -eu
echo '=== AGENTZERO TREE ==='
find /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero -xdev -type f -printf '%P|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
echo '=== FRANK TREE ==='
find /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank -xdev -type f -printf '%P|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
echo OMEGA_SEMANTIC_TREE_FILES_DONE=1
